zh: 会话工具改为按需出现：模型默认只看到 widget_catalog，写组件、放卡、推数据等工具经它的 expose 点名后才注册，常驻上下文从约 1.5k token 降到约 0.2k。
en: Session tools now appear on demand: the model starts with widget_catalog only, and the write/place/push tools register after being named in its expose field, cutting the resident tool context from about 1.5k to 0.2k tokens.
